name: agent-loop
description: Agent-guided single-human development loop with direct edits, adaptive lightweight changes, full Feature workflows, and explicit human gates.

interface.shortDescription: Agent-guided development loop from goal intake to verified close
interface.longDescription: The agent acts as controller: inspects project state, classifies the entry scenario, loads stage-specific references, produces or updates agent-loop artifacts when the selected route owns them, and stops at human gates. Truly trivial deterministic work may use a zero-artifact Direct Edit; persistent Lightweight work repairs first; initial Feature and explicit Bug execution use TDD. Full test runs, Git, and release actions keep exact independent Human authority.
defaultPrompt: I want to initialize agent-loop for this project.
